claim: Activation-patching-based evaluation of unlearning depth achieves higher faithfulness and robustness compared to output-level and white-box baselines.
falsifier: On a new unlearned model, compute the activation-patching-based depth score and compare its faithfulness and robustness against output-level and white-box metrics using the same perturbation suite.

conditions: meta-evaluation across 20 metrics on 150 unlearned models spanning 8 methods
